newsitem.title: CHINA: Family of China dissident leaves court.
newsitem.headline: Family of China dissident leaves court.

text.p: The family of Chinese dissident Wang Dan emerged on Friday from a Beijing court building where they are believed to have attended the appeal hearing of the dissident's 11-year jail sentence, witnesses said.
Uniformed and plainclothes police kept reporters away from the family as they emerged from the building.
Earlier on Friday, police kept foreign reporters at bay as they escorted Wang's family to a bus stop, presumably headed towards the court.

Wang's sentencing by a lower court last month was yet another blow to China's struggling pro-democracy movement. Most dissidents have already been forced into exile or are serving long sentences in prison or labour camps.
Wang had already served four years in prison for his role as a leader of the 1989 student demonstrations for democracy that were crushing by the military with heavy loss of life.
